content: Next, we scrutinize the effectiveness of defense methods when faced against adversarially chosen attacks. Clearly from table 3 , DA and Adv are not effective in this case. We observed that despite a low training error, these models were not able to generalize to attacks on newer words at test time. ATD spell corrector is the most effective on keyboard attacks, but performs poorly on other attack types, particularly the add attack strategy.
